positions.title: Lead Backend Developer
positions.description:
- Developing unit testing for backend API functions.
- Communicate with lead frontend developer and CEO on a regular basis and in weekly scrum meetings.
- Manage eight other backend and full-stack developers by guiding them through tasks, application of Python programming practices, and technical issues with the dev environment including virtual machines.
- Applied concurrency on the backend for proper timing of functions via multithreading.

positions.title: Space Intelligence Analyst
positions.description: Supported U.S. Strategic Command (STRATCOM) at Offutt Air Force Base by performing research and data analysis of international, space-related intelligence. Reviewed foreign systems, facilities, and actions to determine strategy, policy, tactics, operations, force structure, capabilities, and trends; assess threats related to U.S. space / counter-space development programs. Determined solutions for intelligence gaps and to overcome obstacles to data gathering and assessment. Compiled and presented intelligence data in briefings; communicated with military and government officials as well as agencies, organizations, and companies. Utilized technologies to share information; establish priorities and plans; identify requirements and develop data-gap solutions. Served as subject matter expert in counterspace threats such as anti-satellite systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Strategy · Data Aggregation · Data Science · Process Improvement · Military Operations · All-Source Intelligence · Analysis
